page.overview:
Who is Aflac Duck?

The Aflac Duck, also known as The Duck, is a duck that appears in the Aging Animal House. It is the mascot for [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aflac A.F.L.A.C.] (standing for American Family Life Assurance Company) and appears much more aged in The Simpsons than its origins. Its only line is "A.F.L.A.C.!" followed by it coughing: along with its aged appearance it has the voice of an old man.
